Get Parallel is a strategic finance software platform built for early-stage startups, particularly B2B SaaS companies from pre-seed to Series A, enabling founders to forecast cash flow, manage runway and burn, and make data-driven decisions without needing a full finance team.[1][2][3] It solves the core problem of financial opacity in startups by combining AI-powered agents for automated modeling, scenario analysis, and reporting with fractional CFO oversight for strategic validation, integrating seamlessly with tools like QuickBooks, Xero, and Puzzle to deliver live, auditable forecasts.[1][
The company raised $1.85 million in pre-seed funding in 2023 and currently serves early-stage founders and finance teams, reporting one paying customer and multiple alpha/beta users. Investors include Penny Jar Capital, Night Capital, K5 Tokyo Black, Convoi Ventures, Peak Capital, and Frazier Group. This SaaS solution helps founders make confident growth decisions, prepare investor-ready models, and manage budgets efficiently. Get Parallel was founded in April 2023 by Renato Villanueva.
Parallel rides the AI-agent wave in fintech, capitalizing on the explosion of autonomous AI tools that automate white-collar workflows amid economic pressures on startups to optimize cash amid high burn rates and tight funding.[1][4] Timing is ideal post-2023 funding winter, as pre-seed to Series A companies face heightened scrutiny on runway and efficiency during diligence, where traditional spreadsheets fail—Parallel's live integrations and CFO oversight fill this gap, influencing the ecosystem by empowering non-finance founders to treat finance as a "proactive engine" rather than a blocker.[1][2] It amplifies trends like embedded finance and AI copilot adoption, reducing reliance on expensive hires and enabling faster scaling in a market where 80% of startups reportedly struggle with financial modeling.[2]

## What Is Parallel and What Does It Do?  
Parallel, founded in 2024, is a web infrastructure company based in the United States. The company develops systems and APIs enabling AI agents to access, navigate, and utilize the open web efficiently.  
Parallel focuses on building an internet layer optimized for autonomous AI users rather than humans. Its systems allow AI agents to retrieve content, interact with data sources, and perform tasks without friction while incentivizing publishers to keep information publicly accessible.  
Parallel employs between 51-200 employees. Its platform is designed to ensure an open, transparent, and competitive web as AI becomes the primary consumer of online content. Parallel continues to innovate through sustainable models that align publishers, developers, and AI platforms.

# Parallel raises $2.4M to launch the AI-native finance team for startups  
Parallel announced a $2.4M seed round in October 2025 to build out its finance platform and fractional CFO network for early-stage startups.  
Renato Villanueva  
Cofounder  
Editor's note: This announcement reflects Parallel as of October 2025. Our product and positioning have since evolved — see [getparallel.com](https://getparallel.com/blog) for how Parallel works today.
Parallel today announced a $2.4 million seed round and shared its goal of giving early-stage companies finance support that pairs software with a fractional CFO—without the cost and complexity of hiring in-house.  
Renato Villanueva, Cofounder — Oct 9, 2025  
**SALT LAKE CITY — October 9, 2025** — **Parallel** today announced a $2.4 million seed round and set out its goal of giving early-stage companies finance support that combines forecasting software with a fractional CFO—without the cost and complexity of hiring in-house.  
The $2.4 million seed round was led by Night Capital and K5 Tokyo Black, with participation from Penny Jar Capital, Background VC, Mintaka VC, Path Ventures and strategic operators including Jeron Paul (Founder, Spiff), Jared Rodman (Co-founder, Weave), Colin Zima (Founder, Omni) and Alex Bean (Co-founder, Divvy). At the time, the company said the capital would accelerate product development, expand its fractional CFO network, and deepen integrations to keep financial models live and audit ready.
## **Early outcomes**  
"Due diligence finished without a single follow‑up financial question," said Atul Raghunathan, founder of Hyperbound. "What usually takes weeks of back and forth happened in days, with complete investor confidence in our projections."  
"Parallel gave us the clarity and confidence to scale our sales team, timed to cash and targets, in a way we otherwise would not have," said Caleb Hicks, founder of SchoolAI.  
“Finance tools hours every week and we still didn’t have clear answers. Now we spend minutes on decisions we make with 10x the confidence.” — Ethan Whitehead, founder of Salesdraft.  
**What Parallel set out to provide**  
- **A live model:**An accurate forecast built in minutes and kept up to date.
- **Embedded automation:**Workflows for data hygiene, scenario modeling, variance explanations, and board packs.
- **Expert strategic partnership:**A fractional CFO to prep boards, manage fundraising data rooms, and pressure test decisions.  
At the time of this announcement, Parallel served **B2B SaaS** companies from pre-seed through Series A and beyond. Learn more at **getparallel.com**.
## **About Parallel**  
Parallel helps VC‑backed founders get CFO‑level insight without building a finance team. By pairing forecasting software with fractional CFO support, Parallel was built to deliver faster planning, proactive scenarios, and board‑ready reporting, so founders always know their runway and can operate with confidence.  
Media contact: [press@getparallel.com](https://getparallel.com/blog/parallel-seed-round/mailto:press@getparallel.com) | [clint@getparallel.com](https://getparallel.com/blog/parallel-seed-round/mailto:renato@getparallel.com)  
Want to see what Parallel can do for your startup? **Get a Demo**  
Renato Villanueva  
Cofounder

results.name: Parallel Raises $100 million to power AI search infrastructure
results.content:
Parallel Web Systems raised $100 million led by Kleiner Perkins and Index Ventures to build live web search infrastructure for AI agents.
Parallel Web Systems raised $100 million in a Series A round co-led by Kleiner Perkins and Index Ventures. Founded by former Twitter CEO Parag Agrawal, Parallel builds tools for AI agents to search and analyse the web in real time. The funding values the company at $740 million and will speed up product development and customer growth. Parallel, founded by ex-Twitter CEO Parag Agrawal, has secured $100 million to build a new kind of web infrastructure. The system is not for people. It is for artificial intelligence.
It wants to give AI agents direct access to live web data. Parallel believes this will shape how future systems search, read, and understand online content. The Series A round was co-led by Kleiner Perkins and Index Ventures. Khosla Ventures and other existing investors also joined. The funding values Parallel at $740 million, according to reports.
Some funds will also go into addressing paywalls and login barriers that block AI systems from gathering web data. Agrawal said content lockouts are becoming a big challenge. Many publishers are blocking web crawlers to stop AI companies from scraping their data. Parallel plans to build what Agrawal called an “open market mechanism.” The idea is to pay or credit content owners when their pages are used by AI agents. If the model succeeds, it could reshape how information is shared online.
Parallel’s core product, its deep research API, is already being used by developers building coding assistants, knowledge tools, and automated research systems. The company wants to ensure AI agents can work as freely as people do on the web, but with greater accuracy and accountability.
